generatedProse.practice-connection: In the School of Sport, practice- and work-based learning is becoming central, as more courses build links with clubs, clinics, schools and performance settings. Whatever subject you follow, from sport and exercise science to coaching, management or therapy, there is a good chance you will meet it, as a placement, a live project or fieldwork. Treat what follows as being about your own sport placements and projects, not about study in the abstract.
